question: A person suffering from Fregoli delusion is firmly convinced of what?
choices: That various different people they meet are really one persecutor in disguise
That a close relative has been secretly replaced by an identical impostor
That they themselves are already dead
That their own reflection in the mirror is a stranger
anchorText: different people are in fact a single person who changes appearance or is in disguise

question: Ordinary 3-D space has exactly five regular (Platonic) solids. How many regular convex shapes exist in spaces of five dimensions or more?
choices: Exactly three, in every dimension above four
Exactly six, as there are in four dimensions
More and more as the dimension increases
Infinitely many, as with polygons in the plane
anchorText: the simplex, hypercube, and orthoplex are the only regular polytopes
